persona: Backend engineer who acted as product owner for an internal tool
resumeText:
Vikram Desai | Mumbai | vikram.desai@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer, Konkan Fintech, Mumbai (2021 - present)
- Acted as product owner for the internal reconciliation tool; interviewed 15 finance users to find their biggest delays.
- Wrote user stories with acceptance criteria and groomed the backlog with the team.
- Ran two-week sprints as part of a Scrum team.
- Agreed priorities each quarter with finance and operations heads.
- Tracked weekly active users and time-to-reconcile after each release.

Software Engineer, Konkan Fintech (2019 - 2021)
- Built payment APIs in Java and Spring Boot.

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Engineering, VJTI Mumbai, 2019
